title: Free-sheaf homology of a Cech nerve
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $\varphi:F\to G$ be a morphism of presheaves of sets which becomes surjective after sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] (for every object $U$ and $t\in G^\#(U)$ there is a covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ with each $t|_{U_i}$ in the image of $F^\#(U_i)$), and let $K_n=F\times_G\cdots\times_G F$ with $n+1$ factors and the usual face and degeneracy maps (the $j$-th face omits the $j$-th factor, the $j$-th degeneracy repeats it), a simplicial presheaf [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. For a commutative ring $R$, let $R[K_n]^\#$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf of free $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module] $U\mapsto R[K_n(U)]$ on $K_n$. Then the alternating-face complex $\cdots\to R[K_1]^\#\to R[K_0]^\#$, with differential $\sum_j(-1)^jd_j$, has $H_i=0$ for $i>0$, and its augmentation $R[K_0]^\#=R[F]^\#\to R[G]^\#$ induced by $\varphi$ identifies $H_0$ with $R[G]^\#$.

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma Tag 01GC (label lemma-compare-cosk0), lines 590-660. Proof route: let G' be the presheaf image of F to G. Each fibre of its Cech nerve is the nerve of a nonempty set and contracts after choosing one preimage; the free-R chain complex is homotopy equivalent to the free-R complex on G'. Sheafification is exact for modules and G'^#=G^# by local surjectivity. The free-R variant uses the same simplicial contraction.

proof.text: Let $G'\subseteq G$ be the image presheaf of $\varphi$, $G'(U)=\varphi_U(F(U))$ with the restriction maps of $G$, and $\iota:G'\to G$ the inclusion, so $\varphi=\iota\circ\psi$ with $\psi:F\to G'$ surjective on sections over every object. Since $\iota_U$ is injective, a tuple $(f_0,\dots,f_n)\in F(U)^{n+1}$ has equal images in $G(U)$ if and only if it has equal images in $G'(U)$; so $K_n=F\times_{G'}\cdots\times_{G'}F$ as simplicial presheaves, and the augmentation $R[F]\to R[G]$ is $R[\iota]\circ R[\psi]$ with $R[\psi]:R[F]\to R[G']$, $[f]\mapsto[\psi(f)]$.

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma Tag 01GC (label lemma-compare-cosk0), proof (lines 618-660), first sentences: 'Let G' be the image of F -> G. ... the simplicial set K(U) is equal to the simplicial set with n-simplices A x_B ... x_B A'

proof.text: Fix an object $U$ and apply [lem-weil-pbc-set-cech-nerve-free-resolution] to the surjective map of sets $\psi_U:A=F(U)\to B=G'(U)$: by step 1, $K_n(U)=A\times_B\cdots\times_BA$ ($n+1$ factors) with the face maps omitting a coordinate, so $R[K_n(U)]$ with $\sum_j(-1)^jR[d_j]$ is the complex of [lem-weil-pbc-set-cech-nerve-free-resolution] and $R[\psi_U]$ is its augmentation. Hence $\cdots\to R[K_1(U)]\to R[K_0(U)]\xrightarrow{R[\psi_U]}R[G'(U)]\to0$ is exact: $H_i(R[K_\bullet(U)])=0$ for $i>0$ and $R[\psi_U]$ induces $H_0(R[K_\bullet(U)])\cong R[G'(U)]$. (This is Stacks' sectionwise step: $K(U)\to B$ is a trivial Kan fibration (Simplicial, Lemma Tag 01AB), hence a homotopy equivalence (Lemma Tag 08NS), and $s(R[B])$ for the constant simplicial set $B$ has homology $R[B]$ in degree $0$ only (Lemma Tag 0197); [lem-weil-pbc-set-cech-nerve-free-resolution] states the result for the free $R$-module complex, with the contraction given by a chosen preimage in each fibre.)

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma Tag 01GC (label lemma-compare-cosk0), proof (lines 618-660), first paragraph: 'By Simplicial, Lemma 01AB the morphism K(U) -> B is a trivial Kan fibration ... Thus we see that H_i(s(Z_K(U))) = 0 for i > 0, and H_0 = ⊕_{b∈B} Z'; the contraction as in Sites and Sheaves, Lemma Tag 03AT (literature/stacks-project/sites-cohomology.tex, label lemma-homology-complex), last paragraph

proof.text: The complex $R[K_\bullet]$ with differential $\sum_j(-1)^jR[d_j]$ is a complex of presheaves of $R$-modules, and $R[\psi]:R[K_0]=R[F]\to R[G']$ is a morphism of presheaves with $R[\psi]\circ(R[d_0]-R[d_1])=0$ (because $\psi d_0=\psi d_1$ on $K_1$). By [lem-weil-pbc-site-r-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact] (1), kernels, images and homology of complexes of presheaves of $R$-modules are computed sectionwise. So step 2, applied to every object $U$ (its identifications are induced by the presheaf maps $R[\psi]$ and the differentials, hence compatible with restriction maps), gives $H_i(R[K_\bullet])=0$ in $\mathrm{PMod}_R(\mathcal C)$ for $i>0$ and an isomorphism $H_0(R[K_\bullet])\xrightarrow{\sim}R[G']$ induced by $R[\psi]$.

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma Tag 01GC (label lemma-compare-cosk0), proof (lines 618-660), 'These identifications are compatible with restriction maps. We conclude that H_i(s(Z_K)) = 0 for i > 0 and H_0(s(Z_K)) = Z_{G'}, where here we compute homology groups in PAb(C)'

proof.text: Sheafification $\#$ of presheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] is an additive functor, so applying it termwise gives the complex $R[K_\bullet]^\#$ with differential $(\sum_j(-1)^jR[d_j])^\#$, and $R[\psi]^\#:R[F]^\#\to R[G']^\#$. By [lem-weil-pbc-site-r-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact] (2), $\#$ is exact; an exact functor between abelian categories preserves kernels, images and cokernels, hence homology: $H_i(R[K_\bullet]^\#)\cong H_i(R[K_\bullet])^\#$ naturally. By step 3, $H_i(R[K_\bullet]^\#)=0$ for $i>0$ and $R[\psi]^\#$ induces $H_0(R[K_\bullet]^\#)\cong R[G']^\#$.

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma Tag 01GC (label lemma-compare-cosk0), proof (lines 618-660), last sentences: 'Since sheafification is an exact functor we deduce the result of the lemma. Namely, the exactness implies that H_0(s(Z_K))^# = H_0(s(Z_K^#)), and similarly for other indices'

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-image-presheaf-sheafification-iso] (applied to $\varphi$, which becomes surjective after sheafification by hypothesis), $\iota^\#:G'^\#\to G^\#$ is an isomorphism of sheaves of sets. By [lem-weil-pbc-free-module-sheafification-local-iso] (with $u=\iota$), $R[\iota]^\#:R[G']^\#\to R[G]^\#$ is an isomorphism of sheaves of $R$-modules. Composing with step 4, $H_0(R[K_\bullet]^\#)\cong R[G]^\#$ via $R[\iota]^\#\circ R[\psi]^\#=R[\varphi]^\#:R[K_0]^\#=R[F]^\#\to R[G]^\#$ (step 1), which is the augmentation of the statement; and $H_i=0$ for $i>0$.

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma Tag 01GC (label lemma-compare-cosk0), proof (lines 618-660), statement: 'The isomorphism in degree 0 is given by the morphism H_0(K) -> Z_G^# coming from the map (Z_K^#)_0 = Z_F^# -> Z_G^#' (the replacement of Z_{G'}^# by Z_G^# is left implicit in the proof)

split_report.summary: Split following Stacks 01GC (hypercovering.tex 590-660), R-module version. Step 1 replaces G by the presheaf image G' (K is unchanged). Step 2 is the sectionwise computation, Stacks' route through Simplicial 01AB (trivial Kan fibration), 08NS (homotopy equivalence) and 0197 (homology of a constant simplicial object), stated for the free R-module complex of the Cech nerve of a surjection of sets as the new node lem-weil-pbc-set-cech-nerve-free-resolution (unsplit; Mathlib candidate AugmentedCechNerve.extraDegeneracy + ExtraDegeneracy.map + homotopyEquiv; or fibrewise lem-weil-pbc-power-set-complex-contractible of unit sk-thm-p1, which the item does not cite directly because sk-prop-h2 does not cite sk-thm-p1). Step 3 passes to presheaves (sectionwise homology), step 4 sheafifies (exactness), step 5 replaces R[G']^# by R[G]^#, an identification Stacks leaves implicit (its proof computes Z_{G'} while the lemma states Z_G^#). New nodes: lem-weil-pbc-site-r-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact (Mathlib leaf), lem-weil-pbc-free-module-sheafification-local-iso (Mathlib leaf), lem-weil-pbc-image-presheaf-sheafification-iso (unsplit, Mathlib candidate), lem-weil-pbc-set-cech-nerve-free-resolution (unsplit, Mathlib candidate). Statement kept; made explicit what 'surjective after sheafification', the face maps and the augmentation are, and added stmt_deps def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology and def-weil-pbc-free-module. LeanSearch was down (HTTP 500) during this split; Loogle (HTTP), LeanFinder and grep were run.
